scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is over C and concerns smooth rational normal scrolls with all splitting degrees positive. Automorphism dimensions ignore finite disconnected components. Orbit codimension is taken inside the smooth-scroll locus, not the full Hilbert component. The infinite theorem is proved symbolically; finite enumeration is a consistency check only. A residual originality risk remains because the codimension identity may be implicit in classical projective-bundle deformation theory under different terminology.
title: Symmetry defect equals orbit codimension for smooth rational normal scrolls
